description: This Java source file defines utility methods for handling BillingAccount-related operations in the OFBiz accounting system, including retrieval of account balances, order statuses, and related entity queries.

classes.name: BillingAccountWorker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for managing billing accounts, including balance calculations and associated order retrievals.

methods.name: makePartyBillingAccountList
methods.description: Creates a list of billing accounts associated with a party, considering related parties and account status.

methods.name: getBillingAccountOpenOrders
methods.description: Retrieves open orders associated with a specific billing account.

methods.name: getBillingAccountAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance for a billing account, considering its limit and current balance.

methods.name: getBillingAccountNetBalance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance of a billing account, summing applied amounts to invoices and subtracting payments.

methods.name: availableToCapture
methods.description: Determines the amount available for capture from a billing account based on its limit and net balance.

methods.name: calcBillingAccountBalance
methods.description: Service method that returns detailed balance metrics for a specified billing account.

inner_classes.name: BillingAccountComparator
inner_classes.description: Comparator class for sorting billing accounts by their account balance.
